content.title: Metiv Space
content.subtitle: Developing trauma-informed organizations
content.summary: Training and support for organizations and institutions that serve trauma survivors, toward a trauma-informed organizational and service approach.
content.description:
## Personal and national trauma and its impact on organizations

The October 7 disaster and the Iron Swords war have exposed, and continue to expose, many people to severe traumatic events experienced on a personal, family, community and national level. Israeli society now has many people wounded physically and emotionally in the war, bereaved families, and friends who have experienced loss. Many people in the country are in a state of heightened alertness in the face of the ongoing security situation.

Trauma does not stay contained in the therapy room. Often, trauma survivors' encounters with service providers unintentionally trigger a renewed traumatic experience. Cumbersome and unclear bureaucratic processes, a cold or dismissive attitude from service providers, security checks - all of these can stir up feelings of lack of control, a reliving of experiences of humiliation or rejection, and can bring a person who has experienced trauma to frustration, rage and loss of control. These reactions can in turn set off a recurring cycle on the service provider's side.

The **Metiv Space - Developing Trauma-Informed Organizations** program works to reduce these harmful incidents and to create a space that does good for trauma survivors, by helping organizations and institutions build a trauma-aware and trauma-informed approach to their organization and their services.

## What is a trauma-informed organization?

A trauma-informed organization is one that understands the impact of trauma on the individual and the community, and accordingly creates a supportive, safe environment and provides service adapted to it. Such an organization:

- **Creates a safe and supportive environment** for employees and clients
- **Pays attention to the service experience** and to preventing renewed traumatic experiences
- **Builds trust** between clients and the organization, and between employees and the organization
- **Addresses burnout and secondary trauma** among employees
- **Breaks the cycle of traumatic reactions** between employees and clients
- **Deals with the effects of collective trauma**
- **Takes part in the recovery and rehabilitation process** of trauma survivors in Israeli society

## What does the training in organizations include?

- Broadening the understanding of trauma and bereavement: symptoms, typical thought patterns, and how these come into play in encounters with service providers and in the workplace
- Organizational change: what needs to be adapted, changed and developed in the organization, according to guiding principles taught in the training
- Developing interpersonal and intrapersonal skills: for personal coping and for providing trauma-informed service
- Tools for coping with states of arousal, aggression, dissociation and the like

content.title: Building a Trauma-Informed Organization
content.subtitle: A one-day course for HR managers and organizational consultants
content.summary: A seminar day as part of "Metiv Space" on the effects of trauma in the workplace and on adapting procedures, processes and policy.
content.description:
In the course you will broaden your understanding of trauma and its effects on employees and clients, and receive tools for leading your organization as a trauma-informed one.

The most recent published cohort took place on July 15, 2025 (Tuesday, 9:15-15:30, NIS 300). Dates for upcoming courses will be announced.
topics: An understanding of how trauma shows up in the work environment
Principles for creating a trauma-informed organizational environment
Tools for adapting procedures, processes and policy
Practical skills for self-regulation and for managing extreme situations
Ways to embed the change toward a trauma-informed organization

content.title: Customized Workshops and Trainings
content.summary: Workshops and lectures built around the needs of the commissioning organization, for professionals, for employees who encounter trauma survivors, and for groups that have experienced traumatic events.
content.description:
We offer a wide range of customized workshops and lectures for different audiences. We work with mental health professionals, employees who encounter trauma survivors, groups that have experienced traumatic events, as well as schools, government ministries, private companies and more.

We invite you to consult with us about building a workshop for your workplace or peer group.

**Every program is built around the needs of the commissioning organization, adapted as closely as possible to the actual conditions of the setting.**
audience: Groups that have experienced traumatic events
topics: Coping with loss in the workplace
Post-traumatic growth for breast cancer survivors
Crisis and trauma: a bird's-eye view for community leaders
Coping with the reality of war
Family challenges in a reality of war

content.title: Training for Therapeutic Organizations
content.subtitle: A trauma therapist training course for teams
content.summary: A training course in trauma therapy for therapeutic teams in organizations, tailored to the organization's field of work.
content.description:
The training course gives the therapeutic team up-to-date knowledge, clinical experience, practical tools and an understanding of trauma-focused treatment processes.

## What does the organization get?

- In-depth professional knowledge
- Practical tools for work in the field
- A shared therapeutic language
- Tailoring to your organization's field of work
